title: One word... frustration! The holder is the only good thing in this set, we threw away the pump...
text:
One word... frustration! The holder is the only good thing in this set, we threw away the pump.... THE GOOD:
---------------
* Aesthetically, a nice looking set.
* Seems like durable plastic.
* Some sponges included.
* A good holder for toothbrushes, toothpaste, etc. is all it's good for.

THE BAD:
------------
* Terrible pump that did not work out the box. Constantly stuck, and would not pop back up. We diluted 50% water and 50% liquid detergent as instructed.
* Terrible instructions telling us to turn the top a certain way to remove air. The problem is the bottle is an oval design. How the heck do you turn an oval bottle? It just pops back off. There is only one way to put the top on the bottle, and that is straight down. It's a straight down cap.

We have supplemented this set with a different pump bottle. The holder in this set still has a purpose, but the pump is in the trash. I gave the benefit of the doubt to the product too, and assumed user error. So I spent close to an hour trying to get it to work. My wife thought I was crazy. But that's how I am. When something doesn't work, it's a challenge to me. It's no longer about the product, it's about a puzzle I must solve. I could not solve it! A different pump gave us no issues. I can confidently say it's the product, not the user. 1-Star.
